message.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>We define, for each quasisyntomic ring<jats:italic>R</jats:italic>(in the sense of Bhatt et al.,<jats:italic>Publ. Math. IHES</jats:italic><jats:bold>129</jats:bold>(2019), 199–310), a category<jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:inline-graphic xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" mime-subtype="png" xlink:href="S2050508622000221_inline1.png"/><jats:tex-math>$\mathrm {DM}^{\mathrm {adm}}(R)$</jats:tex-math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula>of<jats:italic>admissible prismatic Dieudonné crystals over R</jats:italic>and a functor from<jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-divisible groups over<jats:italic>R</jats:italic>to<jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:inline-graphic xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" mime-subtype="png" xlink:href="S2050508622000221_inline2.png"/><jats:tex-math>$\mathrm {DM}^{\mathrm {adm}}(R)$</jats:tex-math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula>. We prove that this functor is an antiequivalence. Our main cohomological tool is the prismatic formalism recently developed by Bhatt and Scholze.</jats:p>
title: Prismatic Dieudonné Theory
